interpretation: Largest tested fine-grid mean: Square 8 rotors at actual nearest 8 cm, outer edges raised 7.5 degrees, 1.31113810536 N. Nearby Square angles and Circle 10/12.5 have near-equal modeled forces; exact angle/layout superiority is not resolved physically. Fixed-hub inward tilt has positive finite-window-model gains, but continuous/global/hardware optimum and mesh independence are not proven. Maximum lift stays primary; compact alternatives are descriptive, not replacements for the raw leader.

Circle first late-half winner12.5 versus primary/last-half winner10 shows unresolved exact angle.
Contextual equal-box Circle fine sourcepasses but has+1.204484% drift; its pair fails absolute/gain/input checks. It is not a converged causal layout deficit.
Old cold matching-method fine count+21.0950% pair passes. Mapped count+21.8600% pair fails despite both absolute rows passing; retain explicit dagger.
Upstream coarse initialization numerics differ across Square/Circle families. Same target initialization regime/method does not remove that confound.
Electrical/shaft powers are inferred from an assumed loss map; actual blade phase, common RPM, body/guards, added-frame mass and motor maps are unresolved.
Footprint Pareto statements are metric-specific sampled means; Circle may have smaller maximum span despite a larger bounding box.
